title: Slip Coding.pdf — page 35
text:
Steps
1. Select the policy row
• Open the account you are 
modelling.
• In the account table, click on 
the policy row for the peril you 
want to modify.
• The selected row will be 
highlighted with an arrow.
2. Open the Special Conditions 
tab
• At the bottom of the window, 
click the Special Conditions tab.
▪ Condition name
▪ Type of condition – sublimit or policy restriction
▪ Sub-condition of – used to indicate parent-child relationship
▪ Total limit – overall condition limit
▪ Deductible – condition deductible
